plugins.name: att-docs
plugins.description: General documentation skills with a per-repository extension layer

plugins.name: general
plugins.description: Workflow skills that are not tied to one subject (implementing issues, working the backlog) and the repo hooks that read a repository's extension.json

plugins.name: effort-optimizer
plugins.description: Suggests a reasoning effort level for each prompt above the prompt, and switches to it on request or by itself in auto mode

plugins.name: model-router
plugins.description: Picks each subagent's model from Haiku's tier and confidence, and logs each pick and its cost difference

plugins.name: cache-clock
plugins.description: Counts down above the prompt until the chat's prompt cache goes cold, offers a handoff for a large cold chat, and keeps the cache warm on request

plugins.name: efficient-browser-use
plugins.description: Shrinks the screenshots and other pictures tool results carry before Claude reads them, or writes them out in words, and logs the tokens saved

plugins.name: mods
plugins.description: A /mods pane that lists every installed mod and switches each one on or off, shows or hides its band or pane, and reopens a closed pane, in every open chat

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Writes a handoff of a long chat, saves it, and starts a fresh chat from it on Linux

plugins.name: review-queue
plugins.description: Shows above the prompt how many pull requests wait for your review, with each one's CI state and age, across this repository and the ones that pin it

plugins.name: runner-health
plugins.description: Shows a row above the prompt when a self-hosted CI runner is stopped or offline, a job waits too long for one, or a runner disk is low

plugins.name: worktree-sweeper
plugins.description: Shows a band when worktrees are done and a pane that removes them with the checks worktree-cleanup.sh runs

plugins.name: pin-drift
plugins.description: Shows a band in the Overmind repository when a release is pending or a repository that pins Overmind is behind the latest tag, and a pane listing each pin
